title: Prevent slider from extending farther than the last pip

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @redox and @pixelastic to be potential reviewers

@olance we have a strict [contributing policy](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-message-guidelines). Here the tests are failing because your commit message doesn't follow the "Angular.js conventional changelog" pattern.

It should be `fix(rangeSlider):     prevent slider from extending farther than the last pip`.
@redox: Do you think the message you wrote could be added as some part of automatic check by the algobot?
Yes, need to check how to do that; but definitely :)
Basically we could just develop our own algolia contribution bot doing more checks but right now travis already does a decent job
Maybe just posting the Travis error message (if we can get the meaningful one in the list) in the thread.
